# Axion Deep Labs

> Research and development laboratory advancing AI implementation, quantum computing, and intelligent automation. Building production-grade software from original research.

Axion Deep Labs is an R&D company that investigates applied AI, quantum computing, and distributed systems. Our research informs the products we build — production-grade software born from experimentation and rigorous engineering.

## Research

Project DRIFT (Degradation Regimes In Iterated Field Transformations): Investigating behavioral uncertainty in quantum system state evolution under repeated manipulation. Focused on stability degradation under variation in operator ordering and diversity.

## Technical Domains

- AI Implementation & Integration
- Quantum Computing Research
- Intelligent Automation
- Distributed Systems
- Spatial Computing & XR
- Applied Mathematics

## Products

- [Site2CRM](https://site2crm.io): AI-powered lead capture with real-time CRM sync
- [Made4Founders](https://made4founders.com): Startup command center for solo founders
- [QUANTA](https://axiondeep.com/projects/quanta): Quantum computing education platform
- [Vesper AI](https://axiondeep.com/projects/vesper): Autonomous penetration testing platform
- [Forma](https://axiondeep.com/projects/forma): Component-driven design system
